guides.title: Quick pick: what to run right now
guides.body:
| Situation | Run this |
|---|---|
| Shipment or any tiny map | VEL 46 Shredder or ISO Nightshade Rush |
| Normal 6v6, you want one class for everything | Cronen Osprey Suppressed or M4 All-Rounder |
| Low level, few unlocks | Han 86 Starter |
| Hardpoint / Domination | ISO Nightshade Rush, or Type 73 to hold the point |
| Big maps, long lanes | Kastov Lane Control or KG-7 Vulcan |
| Search and Destroy | KG-7 Vulcan + ISO |

Sites disagree on the single best assault rifle (Axion, Hyeon Burst and Han 86 each top a list). The VEL 46 and KG-7 Vulcan are in nearly every list.

*Meta as of 14 November 2026 (Season 1, after the 12 November update). Ask Claude to refresh this after each balance patch.*

guides.title: Shipment: classes and tips
guides.body:
## Perks for Shipment
**Quick Fix, Fast Hands, Scavenger** on every class below. Swap one for **Battle Hardened** if the stun and flash spam is bad (it usually is), and consider **Bomb Squad** against explosives.

## Top 5 classes
| # | Weapon | Attachments |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | M4 (suppressed) | XRK Mil-Tac Suppressor, SZ Gen.6 PEQ, ZLR Phase Grip, FSS Fireline Grip, 5.56 NATO High Velocity |
| 2 | VEL 46 | XRK Herder 40, VB-46 Series 11, XRK Clutch-LS, V46 R-Skel Grip, FSS Fireline Grip, VEL 46 Snap |
| 3 | ISO Nightshade | XRK Herder 40, RT Outride-X 8", Schlager Visiv-5, Demo STP-1, Mire-50 Tac Grip |
| 4 | Han 86 | FSS IS300, Schlager Visiv-5, Meiko L9P-Fold, Hanbit H86 Grip, FSS Fireline Grip |
| 5 | Patriot XMR | ZLR Cold Echo, SZ Gen.6 PEQ, IOTA-D, Schlager ATTACK-7 Grip, FSS Fireline Grip |

Also strong here: Rezi 12, and the Wz.55 Striga with its akimbo Rampage Apex.

## Tips
- Keep moving, never stand in the open lanes between containers.
- Reload behind cover, not mid-lane.
- Best modes for kills: Team Deathmatch, Kill Confirmed.
- Best map for levelling guns and camo challenges.

*Meta as of 14 November 2026 (Season 1, after the 12 November update). Ask Claude to refresh this after each balance patch.*

guides.title: Perk packages
guides.body:
Three perks, two grenades, one field upgrade.

| Style | Perks | Grenades | Field upgrade |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aggressive / kills | Quick Fix, Blood Rush, Battle Hardened | Concussion, Frag | Portable Radar |
| Sneaky | Ghost, Ninja, Cold Blooded | Concussion, Frag | Portable Radar |
| Objective | Ghost, Birdseye, Combat Grid | Smoke, Thermite | Trophy System |
| Killstreak farming | Kill Chain, Hardline, Battle Hardened | Stim, Thermite | Riot Shield |

## What they do
- **Quick Fix**: health regen restarts on a kill or objective capture.
- **Blood Rush**: Tactical Sprint.
- **Battle Hardened**: less effect from stuns and flashes.
- **Ghost**: hidden from UAVs. **Ninja**: quieter movement. **Cold Blooded**: hidden from drones and thermal scopes.
- **Birdseye**: bigger minimap with enemy facing. **Combat Grid**: see enemy streaks and equipment through walls.
- **Kill Chain**: streak kills count towards the next streak. **Hardline**: streaks cost one kill less.
- **Overkill**: two primaries. **Fast Hands**: faster reload and swap. **Scavenger**: ammo from bodies. **Bomb Squad**: less explosive damage.

guides.title: Camo ladder and challenges by weapon class
guides.body:
## Per weapon, in order
1. **Military camos (8)**: unlock by levelling the weapon.
2. **Special camos (3)**: one challenge each, shown on the weapon in game.
3. **Gold**: 15 kills in one multiplayer match.
4. **Platinum**: see table.
5. **Harmonic Break**: see table.

**Divergence** unlocks for the whole account when Harmonic Break is done on all 33 launch weapons. The mastery camos come after it.

## Multiplayer challenges
| Class | Platinum | Harmonic Break |
|---|---|---|
| Assault rifle | 50 headshots | 25 double kills |
| SMG | 25 kills from behind | 50 hipfire kills |
| Shotgun | 50 hipfire kills | 2 kills without reloading, 25 times |
| LMG | 3 kills without dying, 15 times | 2 kills without releasing the trigger, 25 times |
| Marksman rifle | 75 kills while prone | 75 one-shot kills |
| Sniper | 75 kills while prone | 75 one-shot kills |
| Pistol | 20 kills from behind | 40 hipfire kills |
| Launcher | 2 kills without taking damage, 15 times | 10 kills in a match, 7 times |
| Melee | 3 kills without dying, 15 times | 25 kills from behind |

## Mastery (multiplayer, per weapon, after Divergence)
| Camo | Challenge |
|---|---|
| Mercurial Drift | 10 kills in a match, 250 times |
| Polyatomic Reforged | 3 kills without taking damage, 300 times |
| Orion Reforged | 5 kills without dying, 500 times |

Fastest place for almost all of these: Shipment.
